|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Rebel Tech (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Opponent's game text on your non-docking bay Yavin 4 sites is canceled. During your turn, may place in Used Pile to ▲ Death Star: Trench or Advance Preparation. Cumulatively adds 1 to your Attack Run total.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Dark Side game text on your non-docking bay Yavin 4 sites is canceled. Your Attack Run total is cumulatively +1. During your turn, may place this Rebel Tech in Used Pile to take one Advance Preparation or Death Star: Trench into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' “Opponent's” → “Dark Side”; added “Your Attack Run total is cumulatively +1.”; added “this Rebel Tech”; “▲” → “take one Advance Preparation or”; “or Advance Preparation. Cumulatively adds 1 to your Attack Run total.” → “into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153955/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards3.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 2, slip 17. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Rebel Tech]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 3: Revolution#Cards|Virtual Set 3: Revolution]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Rebel Tech (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Rebel Tech]]. Code OVS3 · GEMP id 1103_17.
